summary: Andre Karpathy joins Anthropic to lead pre-training research utilizing their AI Claude, sparking discussions in the AI community regarding the future of automated AI research, particularly in the context of recursive self-improvement. His previous project, AutoResearch, demonstrates a simplified and effective approach to machine learning research that could enhance training efficiency considerably if applied at scale.

AI talent wars and lab dynamics
